description: Single source of truth for reward parameters shared by training, evaluation, the Godot environment, and both GUIs.

progress_gain.label: Forward progress reward
progress_gain.description: Multiplier for bounded forward progress along the route.

max_speed_reward.label: Top-speed reward (per step)
max_speed_reward.description: Signed per-step bonus at top speed. A negative value intentionally penalizes top speed.

lane_penalty.label: Lane deviation penalty
lane_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted for deviation from the lane centre.

edge_penalty.label: Road-edge penalty
edge_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted for pressure toward the road edge.

heading_penalty.label: Wrong-heading penalty
heading_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted for heading error.

step_penalty.label: Per-step penalty
step_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted on every environment step.

crash_penalty.label: Crash penalty
crash_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted when an episode ends in a crash.

off_road_penalty.label: Off-road penalty
off_road_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted when an episode ends off the drivable area.

goal_reward.label: Goal reward
goal_reward.description: Reward added when the vehicle reaches the goal.

timeout_penalty.label: Timeout penalty
timeout_penalty.description: Positive magnitude subtracted when an episode reaches its step limit.
